notes: Shooting a projectile at targets makes this Shooter even though the ammunition is cornflakes, but none of the nine presets survives contact with it: every competitive one needs an opposing team, PvE Shooter needs waves entering from a spawner when the round here ends once a fixed population of shoppers is down, and Aim Trainer's firing line contradicts a player who walks the floor — so preset is none and the picks are built up directly. The shape came from outside Shooter's shortlist: the scale answer says one big shop floor and nothing else, so interior-single is right, the whole map being one enclosed venue with no exterior to generate. That is also why there is no P3 here — a supermarket sounds like an interior transition, but interior-single means the player never crosses one, so the build stays P0. Without a user I filed the shoppers as npc-population rather than spawner-npc, because they inhabit the store and are downed where they stand rather than being hostiles fed in, and read the shelf aisles as the cover arrays; the cartoony treatment and the cornflake gun are dressing no option carries.
